   {"name": "balance", "event": "Before the call, from client's account balance", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
   {"name": "housing", "event": "Before the call, from client's housing loan status", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
   {"name": "job", "event": "Before the call, from client's profile", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
   {"name": "campaign", "event": "Before the call, number of contacts during this campaign so far", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
   {"name": "month", "event": "Before the call, the month is known", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
   {"name": "pdays", "event": "Before the call, days since last contact from previous campaign", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0}
 ]
